items.title: Dolly Parton Remembered: Taylor Swift, Reba McEntire, Kacey Musgraves, and More Pay Tribute
items.summary: Shania Twain, Beyoncé, Cyndi Lauper, Jane Fonda, Paul McCartney, Joan Jett, Jack White, and Carol Burnett have each shared their own memories of the country legend, who died today at the age of 80

items.title: Dolly Parton Dies at 80
items.summary: Her publicist confirmed a small, private service will be held for immediate family.
